blocks.text: How do you get a medical fitness certificate online?

To get a medical fitness certificate online with DrCertificate, fill in the online form, choose the Medical Fitness Certificate option and pay through Stripe. An independent certified doctor reviews your details by chat and, if satisfied, emails the certificate as a PDF, usually in about 30 minutes. Issuance depends on the doctor's judgement.
Before you apply
About this certificate
What is a medical fitness certificate?
A medical fitness certificate is an official document issued by a qualified doctor. It states that you have been medically assessed and are considered fit for a particular activity or requirement.
Organisations may ask for one to make sure you can safely perform certain duties, take part in activities or meet health-related eligibility criteria.
What a certificate includes
These details help employers, universities and organisations confirm the certificate followed a proper medical evaluation.

Avoid fake certificates. Blank templates, edited sample certificates and fake certificate generators may lead to rejection. A genuine certificate is issued only after a real health assessment by a qualified doctor.

Every request is assessed individually. Issuing a certificate, its content and its duration are at the reviewing doctor's discretion. All documents are addressed to the organisation they are submitted to and are valid for single use only. Acceptance depends on the organisation you submit it to.
What do employers, schools or airlines usually expect from a medical fitness certificate?

Employers, schools and airlines usually expect a medical fitness certificate to show your full name, a plain fitness statement, a recent date and the doctor's name and registration. Beyond that, each recipient sets its own rules, and those rules differ by employer, institution, airline and country.

Formal workplace exams follow their own law. In the Philippines, the Omnibus Rules that carry out the Labor Code say the physician engaged by an employer shall conduct a free pre employment medical examination for the proper selection and placement of workers, plus a free annual physical examination.

Singapore's Ministry of Manpower says employers must send employees exposed to named occupational hazards for pre placement and regular medical examinations. The same ministry says the migrant worker medical examination screens for 4 types of infectious diseases and checks whether the worker is fit to work. An online note does not replace any of those exams.
Before you apply, ask the recipient three questions.
Does it accept online medical notes? Does it have its own form or format? How recent must the certificate be?

blocks.text: What does a medical fitness certificate include?

A DrCertificate medical fitness certificate includes your personal details, the date of issue, the doctor's fitness statement and the issuing doctor's details. Recipients can read the layout at a glance.
The doctor's section shows the doctor's name, medical qualification and medical council registration details, which a recipient can use to check the doctor.
The dates show when the doctor reviewed your request and, where relevant, the period the statement covers. In most South East Asian countries, fitness notes are generally valid for 30 days.
Write the purpose of the certificate in the form if you want the statement to mention it.

blocks.text: You'll continue on the secure DrCertificate application form.
Which option should you choose on the form for a medical fitness certificate?

Choose the Medical Fitness Certificate option, which covers employee fitness, student fitness and good health certificates. The same option is used for sports fitness, fit to fly and fit to work requests.
In the details box, write who will receive the certificate and what it is for, for example a new job, a university course or a flight date.
If no option fits, email care@drcertificate.com before you pay.
What will the doctor ask you for a medical fitness certificate?
The doctor will ask about your current health, past illnesses and the date and purpose of the certificate. Clear answers help the doctor decide faster.

Expect questions on ongoing conditions, recent illness or injury, regular medicines and any symptoms during exercise or daily activity. Your name and ID details must match each other, because a mismatch is one of the reasons doctors decline. If you have recent reports from a clinic, mention them in the form.
Keep your phone or email close by.
The doctor may send follow-up questions in the chat before making a decision.
Where can a medical fitness certificate not be used?
A DrCertificate medical fitness certificate cannot be used for submission in India, for legal purposes or for insurance. Applicants must be at least 16 years old.

The service is for suitable non emergency situations only. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, a severe injury or any urgent symptom, go to your nearest emergency department or call local emergency services straight away.
The recipient decides whether to accept the certificate, so check with them first.
What happens if the doctor cannot issue your medical fitness certificate?
If the doctor cannot issue your medical fitness certificate, you receive no certificate and the payment is not refunded. Doctors decline about 2% of requests.

The usual reasons are wrong details, like a name that does not match the ID, or symptoms and answers that do not line up. A doctor will also decline when your situation needs an in person examination or tests, for example an employer's pre employment exam or a government medical screening. In that case, visit a clinic or the doctor your recipient names.
Payments are non refundable. The one exception is a verified technical fault reported within 24 hours.
For help, email care@drcertificate.com.
What does a medical fitness certificate cost?
A medical fitness certificate costs 25 SGD in Singapore, 399 pesos in the Philippines and 30 MYR in Malaysia. Prices in other countries depend on the country.
The fee covers the doctor's review and, if approved, the PDF certificate. Payment is through Stripe and is non refundable.

blocks.text: Will my employer, school or airline accept a medical fitness certificate?

Your employer, school or airline will accept a medical fitness certificate only if its own policy allows online medical notes. DrCertificate cannot decide that for the recipient, so ask before you apply.

All doctors on the platform are registered with a medical council. A recipient who wants to verify the certificate can check the doctor's name and registration details against that council's register.
If the recipient requires its own form, ask whether it will take the DrCertificate format instead. If the answer is no, visit a clinic in person.

FAQs
Questions about medical fitness certificates
What is an online Fitness Certificate?

An online Fitness Certificate is a digital document issued by a certified doctor (MBBS, MD or MS) stating that you were assessed as fit for a job, activity, sport or travel. The doctor reviews your health details, may contact you by secure digital chat, and decides whether to issue it.
How quickly can I receive my certificate?

For fitness cases, doctors review requests from 9 am to 9 pm IST Monday to Saturday, and 10 am to 8 pm IST on Sunday. A request made outside those hours is reviewed in the next working slot. If the doctor approves your request, your certificate is sent to your email.
Is the service available every day?
Yes, the service runs 365 days a year, including weekends and public holidays. A doctor reviews requests during working hours, so a request made outside those hours waits for the next working slot.
Can I get a Fitness Certificate in my local language?
A certificate in a local language is not promised. Email care@drcertificate.com to ask before you apply.
Who issues the Online Fitness Certificate?
A certified doctor (MBBS, MD or MS) issues the certificate. The doctor works independently and alone decides whether to issue it and what it says. The certificate is not for submission in India.
How much does a certificate cost?

The price depends on your country, for example 25 SGD in Singapore, 399 pesos in the Philippines or 30 MYR in Malaysia. The application form shows the price before you pay. Payments are non-refundable, including when a doctor declines a request.
Are these certificates accepted by employers and institutions?
Acceptance depends on the organisation you submit it to, so check first. A certified doctor issues the certificate, so ask whether they accept that.
Can I obtain a Fitness Certificate on Public Holidays?
Yes, you can apply on a public holiday, because the service runs 365 days a year. A doctor reviews your request during working hours.
What if my employer or institution has specific format requirements?
Email care@drcertificate.com with the format before you apply, because a change of format is not guaranteed. Acceptance depends on the organisation you submit it to, so check first.
How long is a medical fitness certificate valid?

A medical fitness certificate is generally valid for 30 days in most South East Asian countries. The recipient sets the final rule, and an employer, school or airline may want a note issued closer to your start date or flight. Check their time window before you apply.
Can a medical fitness certificate be backdated?

A medical fitness certificate reflects the doctor's assessment at the time of the chat review, so ask for the dates you need in the form and let the doctor decide. The doctor will only state what your details support. Recipients usually want a recent date, not an old one.
How is the medical fitness certificate delivered?

Approved medical fitness certificates arrive by email as a PDF, usually in about 30 minutes. Use an email address you can open on your phone, and check your spam folder if the message has not arrived. You can print the PDF or forward it to the recipient.
Can I correct my name or dates after the certificate is issued?

A medical fitness certificate cannot be corrected once issued, unless the mistake came from the medical team. Check your name, ID and dates on the form carefully before you pay. If the doctor made the error, email care@drcertificate.com and explain what needs changing.
Can I use a medical fitness certificate in my country?

DrCertificate serves 10 South East Asian countries, including Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and the Philippines, plus Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar and Brunei. The certificate is not for submission in India. Acceptance depends on the recipient, so confirm that your employer, school or airline takes online notes.
Is my health information kept private?

Your health information goes to the independent doctor reviewing your request and is used for that review. Share only what the form and the doctor ask for. For questions about how DrCertificate stores or handles your data, email care@drcertificate.com before you apply.
Do I need a video call to get a medical fitness certificate?

No video or in person consultation is needed for a DrCertificate medical fitness certificate. The doctor reviews your form and chats with you in writing. If your case calls for a hands on check or lab work, the physician will refuse and advise you to see a clinic instead.
